description: 臺中市消防栓水源位置資料 [fire, police and emergency services and drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府消防局. 消防栓點位資料，茲因消防安全變得越來越重要，為了協助在緊急情況下快速取得消防栓的位置，由消防栓提供即時的水源，迅速滅火，在火災發生時能及時應對，減少火災擴散的可能性。. Coverage: 臺中市政府消防局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府消防局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
